related.title: NSEC3：歷史迭代雜湊的工作量稽核
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：時間gate通過仍須真正驗證器檢查信任鏈；本實驗只接受時間分類結果。 交接時須能核對：交付 rrsig-time.csv、時鐘偏移對照及驗證階段責任表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: A passing time gate still requires a real validator and trust chain; this exercise accepts only time classification. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver rrsig-time.csv, clock-skew comparisons and a validation-stage responsibility table.
related.difference: 按名稱記錄初始及額外雜湊呼叫數，把salt輸入與iterations分成不同欄。
related.differenceEn: Count initial and additional calls per name, keeping salt and iterations separate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
DNSSEC驗證包含簽章、信任鏈與有效時間；通過時間檢查不足以證明真偽。
教學基準：1700003600-1700001200 = 2400 s；對照：1700003600-1700003700 = -100 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

NSEC3 iterations欄位代表初始雜湊之外的額外輪次；本課分析舊紀錄，不建議提高迭代值。
教學基準：1000*(10+1) = 11000 hash calls；對照：1000*(0+1) = 1000 hash calls。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
DNSSEC validation includes cryptography, trust chains and validity time; passing the time gate alone proves no authenticity.
Teaching baseline: 1700003600-1700001200 = 2400 s; comparison: 1700003600-1700003700 = -100 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

NSEC3 iterations count rounds after the initial hash; this course audits historical records and does not recommend higher iterations.
Teaching baseline: 1000*(10+1) = 11000 hash calls; comparison: 1000*(0+1) = 1000 hash calls. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TCP Window Scale：接收窗與 BDP 驗收
related.titleEn: TCP Window Scale: receive windows and bandwidth-delay product
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：時間gate通過仍須真正驗證器檢查信任鏈；本實驗只接受時間分類結果。 交接時須能核對：交付 rrsig-time.csv、時鐘偏移對照及驗證階段責任表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: A passing time gate still requires a real validator and trust chain; this exercise accepts only time classification. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver rrsig-time.csv, clock-skew comparisons and a validation-stage responsibility table.
related.difference: 保留雙端SYN選項與資料階段window欄，將接收方向標明。
related.differenceEn: Retain both SYN options and data-phase window fields with explicit receive direction.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
DNSSEC驗證包含簽章、信任鏈與有效時間；通過時間檢查不足以證明真偽。
教學基準：1700003600-1700001200 = 2400 s；對照：1700003600-1700003700 = -100 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Window Scale在SYN協商後縮放接收窗欄位；SYN封包內的window本身不被縮放。
教學基準：65535*2**7 = 8388480 B；對照：65535*2**8 = 16776960 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
DNSSEC validation includes cryptography, trust chains and validity time; passing the time gate alone proves no authenticity.
Teaching baseline: 1700003600-1700001200 = 2400 s; comparison: 1700003600-1700003700 = -100 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Window Scale negotiated in SYN scales later receive-window fields; the SYN window itself is not scaled.
Teaching baseline: 65535*2**7 = 8388480 B; comparison: 65535*2**8 = 16776960 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
